title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025

qualification: Pursuing BS/MS/PhD in CS or STEM field
description: Google Software Engineering Internships offer students hands-on experience building scalable technology solutions alongside full-time Google engineers.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: International students applying for full-time postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Bachelor's degree with exceptional academic record and leadership potential
description: Provides full-cost awards for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates skilled in JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript/React and modern web technologies
description: Work remotely from anywhere in the world on WordPress.com applications, contributing to open-source software and modern web interfaces.

description: Rotational program designed to train the next generation of product leaders across core products like Instagram, WhatsApp, and Facebook.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science

description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan that introduces students to algorithmic thinking and computer science concepts using C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
